FN-XL1FZ7E-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/10/2025
Senate Bill 39 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Examiners
and Public Accounts (EPA) by a small undetermined amount to provide an online/in-person
board governance course to all board members of boards subject to the Alabama Sunset Law.
In addition, this bill will increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the Attorney
General to work in consultation with the EPA, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, in
determining the course curriculum for the board governance course.

FN-XL1FZ7E-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 39 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts (EPA) by a small, undetermined amount to provide a board
governance course to all board members of boards subject to the Alabama Sunset Law.
In addition, this bill will also increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the
Attorney General to determine the course curriculum for the course, in consultation with the
EPA, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
